audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Gaucher disease type I and the Gaucher disease-ophthalmoplegia-cardiovascular calcification syndrome are both linked to the gene GBA1 in curated databases [e_d56da1ee4888] [e_52fde480951a].
Constellate computed that their listed symptoms overlap somewhat, with a score of 0.188 [e_4787902a01ca].
That score is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_4787902a01ca].
For the calcification syndrome, slowed eye movements and calcium build-up in the aorta, the main body artery, are listed [e_610ebaccd247] [e_5c779fb88146].
The eye movement entry has a low confidence of 0.5, and the aorta entry has 0.6 [e_610ebaccd247] [e_5c779fb88146].
For type I, a completed phase 3 study in children and a recruiting biomarker study are listed [e_e5b3331b78b8] [e_91a2d1ff7629].
A listed study shows research is happening and does not show what it found [e_e5b3331b78b8].
These edges list no study for the calcification syndrome [e_52fde480951a].
